title: Is There a Giant Cave Under the Moon? NASA Wants to Find Out
summary:
There is a big hole on the Moon called the Marius Hill Pit. Scientists think it might lead to a huge cave or lava tube underground. A lava tube is a tunnel made by flowing lava long ago.

NASA has picked a project called GIMLI to find out. Scientist Than Putzig of the Planetary Science Institute leads it. The tools will ride to the Moon on a lander and a rover.

GIMLI will use radar, sensors that feel vibrations in rock, a tool that measures gravity, and cameras. Together, they could show if an empty space stretches away from the pit and how big it is.

A cave could someday protect astronauts from radiation and from the Moon's very hot and very cold temperatures. It could also hold clues about the Moon's volcanoes long ago.

Even if there is no cave, the mission could help explain how the pit formed.
why_it_matters: A safe cave on the Moon could someday help astronauts live and explore there.
